title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
organization: Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation / University of Cambridge
eligibility: Non-UK citizens applying to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge.
qualification: Bachelor's degree with outstanding academic performance and leadership potential.
description: Full-cost scholarships awarded to outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree in any subject available at Cambridge.

title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related field.
qualification: Experience with Data Structures, Algorithms, and coding in C++, Java, or Python.
description: Engage in real-world software engineering challenges, work directly with product teams, and build scalable infrastructure at Google.

title: Junior Web Developer
eligibility: Early-career developers eligible to work remotely in their local time zone.
qualification: Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience; strong JavaScript, HTML/CSS skills.
description: Canonical is seeking a remote web developer to work on front-end features across sites supporting Ubuntu and Canonical enterprise software.

title: Associate Data Scientist
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals in CS, Data Analytics, or Statistics.
qualification: Proficiency in Python, SQL, Machine Learning concepts, and data visualization tools.
description: Work with business teams to create statistical models, analyze data pipelines, and apply AI tools to solve client problems.

title: Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 18+ enrolled in an accredited secondary or post-secondary institution.
qualification: Working knowledge of Azure Cloud services and AI technologies to present a tech solution.
description: Microsoft's annual global student technology competition encouraging students to build purposeful solutions leveraging AI and Cloud technologies.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide; no prior programming experience required.
qualification: High school level mathematics or equivalent interest in computer science fundamentals.
description: An entry-level course teaching concepts of algorithmic thinking, problem-solving, C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
